warning: No government scheme exists providing ₹50,000 direct cash transfers to all citizens or farmers. Beware of phishing links.
real_facts: The legitimate PM-KISAN scheme provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to eligible landholding farmers.
citation: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture, Page 2

warning: Central Government is not running any direct nationwide 'Free Laptop 2026' registration link on WhatsApp.
real_facts: Legitimate educational assistance is provided via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scholarships through the official National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
citation: PIB Fact Check & Ministry of Electronics & IT Advisory
